snippet.title: ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Together, bound by a will.
To cross the endless night, and fight on.
As Night falls, we rise.
 
#ELDENRING #NIGHTREIGN launches May 30, 2025.
Pre-order today: https://www.bandainamcoent.com/games/nightreign
